```{=html}
<style>
#title-block-header { display: none; }
#quarto-content main.content { max-width: 1300px; width: 100%; }
#foul-dashboard { width: 100%; border: 0; min-height: 1500px; display: block; }
.foul-links { display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; font-size: .9rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
</style>
<div class="foul-links"><a href="?view=teams">Teams</a><a href="?view=players">Players</a><a href="?view=refs">Referees</a></div>
<iframe id="foul-dashboard" src="../assets/fouls/dashboard.html" title="Foul Analysis dashboard with team, player, and referee views" loading="eager"></iframe>
<script>
const frame = document.getElementById('foul-dashboard');
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const clean = new URLSearchParams();
if (['teams','players','refs'].includes(params.get('view'))) clean.set('view',params.get('view'));
if (/^202[1-7]$/.test(params.get('season') || '')) clean.set('season',params.get('season'));
frame.src = '../assets/fouls/dashboard.html?' + clean.toString();
window.addEventListener('message', event => {
  if (event.origin !== window.location.origin || event.source !== frame.contentWindow) return;
  if (Number.isFinite(event.data?.foulHeight)) frame.style.height = Math.max(800,Math.min(20000,event.data.foulHeight+20))+'px';
  if (['teams','players','refs'].includes(event.data?.foulView)) {
    const next = new URL(window.location);
    next.searchParams.set('view',event.data.foulView);
    next.searchParams.set('season',event.data.season);
    window.history.replaceState(null,'',next);
  }
});
</script>
```
